en.html:
Of course—the sixth sense!

The super-sense said to belong to people born with extraordinary gifts, or warriors who have reached the realm of the gods. No way to survive except awaken it now. The qualifications could be obtained while doing the work.

I concentrated. Somewhere in my brain, an unused department must be there. Open it. Emergency recruitment. No time for the interview.

ja.html:
そうだ――第六感！


　特殊な天性の才を持つ者が、あるいは神域に至った
武人が備えるという――<ruby>超感覚<rt>シックス・センス</rt></ruby>。
　これに覚醒する以外に活路はない。

　俺は精神を集中し、脳内の未知の領域を開拓しよう
と試みた。
